Levels.facedetection: Face detection task: whole scene visible, 6 s limit.
Levels.movingwindow: Moving-window task: only a gaze-contingent aperture around fixation visible, 20 s limit.

Levels.Face size: Face size, column 1 of size_locs in stimulus_features/face_size_eccentricity.mat.
Face eccentricity, column 2 of size_locs in stimulus_features/face_size_eccentricity.mat.
Levels.Body size: Body size, column 1 of size_locs in stimulus_features/body_size_eccentricity.mat.
Body eccentricity, column 2 of size_locs in stimulus_features/body_size_eccentricity.mat.
Levels.SceneFaceDet: CNN face/no-face distance, array layer_means_resp_face_cos_f_n, layer index 6 (last fully connected layer), of stimulus_features/cnn_scenefacedet.npz.

preview_beta.Description: Standardised regression coefficient in the full 9-predictor model, mean across folds; predictor and dependent variable z-scored within each training fold. Negative means faster detection. Not noise-corrected. Condition: preview.

preview_beta_sd.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For preview_beta.

preview_r2.Description: Unique predictivity: predictivity of the full 9-predictor model minus that of the same model without this predictor. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY). Condition: preview.

preview_r2_ci95_low.Description: Lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of preview_r2: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 2.5th percentile.

preview_r2_ci95_high.Description: Upper bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of preview_r2: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 97.5th percentile.

preview_p.Description: One-sided permutation p for predictivity > 0: latencies shuffled across images and the whole cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations, p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + 5000). For preview_r2.

preview_p_bonferroni.Description: preview_p multiplied by 20 (ten features x two conditions), capped at 1.

no_preview_beta.Description: Standardised regression coefficient in the full 9-predictor model, mean across folds; predictor and dependent variable z-scored within each training fold. Negative means faster detection. Not noise-corrected. Condition: no-preview.

no_preview_beta_sd.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For no_preview_beta.

no_preview_r2.Description: Unique predictivity: predictivity of the full 9-predictor model minus that of the same model without this predictor. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY). Condition: no-preview.

no_preview_r2_ci95_low.Description: Lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of no_preview_r2: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 2.5th percentile.

no_preview_r2_ci95_high.Description: Upper bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of no_preview_r2: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 97.5th percentile.

no_preview_p.Description: One-sided permutation p for predictivity > 0: latencies shuffled across images and the whole cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations, p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + 5000). For no_preview_r2.

no_preview_p_bonferroni.Description: no_preview_p multiplied by 20 (ten features x two conditions), capped at 1.

delta_ci95_low.Description: Lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of delta: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 2.5th percentile.

delta_ci95_high.Description: Upper bound of the 95% bootstrap CI of delta: 1000 resamples of images with replacement, the whole cross-validation rerun with copies of an image kept in the same fold; 97.5th percentile.

delta_p.Description: Two-sided permutation p for delta: the two condition means are exchanged for a random subset of images and the cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations; the null is recentred to remove the offset that the two different reliabilities place on it.
